title: LADA Y vs LADA R, Sep 28
notes: Away game at Renton against LADA R, LADA's other team: we wore light blue on the left (away) bench, LADA R white with blue numbers. The video came as 3246x1440 and was scaled up to Renton's usual 3840x1702. The same video was processed for LADA R's site.

Periods from the arena scoreboard: 0:23-18:37, 20:13-38:14 and 39:48-65:42 of the video (the empty-ice proposal found a single period). The board ran a 1:00 intermission countdown after the 1st and the 2nd. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn. Hilfer #31 was in our net, the left one in the 1st and 3rd, the right in the 2nd.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, placed in the video by the scoreboard and checked by eye: ours at 5:12 (clock 13:05, 1st, Akulov #37 from Barkov #97 and Lisitsyn #70) and 16:08 (2:05, 1st, Barkov #97 from Olyanich #89 and Unuchek #49); LADA R's at 26:49 (11:15, 2nd, #57 Moshchuk from #12) and 46:58 (12:28, 3rd, #57 Moshchuk from #12 and #64). Final 2-2.
Shots on goal from the board: LADA Y 31, LADA R 22 (14-4, 7-6, 10-12 by period). SportNinja's sheet has us at 32 (11 in the 3rd).

Penalties, from the board's panels and the players skating into the box: Shakhov #78 tripping in the 2nd (whistle at 21:29 of the video; the board ran 3:00, the first 76 s 4 on 4 while LADA R's #10 finished his hooking minor from the 1st) and Lisitsyn #70 slashing in the 3rd (61:43; 2:00, with 0:42 left at the final horn). The sheet calls both 2-minute minors.

Played: 13 skaters, LADA's planned lines without Beregovoy #87. Didn't play: Belousenko #11, Kondratenko #12, Beregovoy (#67 and #87) and Mischenko #72; the sheet agrees, and none of their nameplates was read. The 598 reads of 12 were LADA R's #12 Sergeev, whose white jersey with blue numbers passes part of our light-blue test.

No review rows were labeled by hand. Three lineup stretches were checked in full frames and fixed with on/off entries: P1 from the 13:02 line change (Sokolov #4 on), P1 15:26-16:42 (Olyanich #89 on, at the net for Barkov's goal; Podkorytov #82 off) and P3 44:13-44:42 (Akulov #37 off).

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 13:05: Akulov #37 pokes it in from a scramble at the crease, 1-0
1st period, clock 2:05: Barkov #97 drives in on the goalie and scores, 2-0
2nd period, clock 11:15: LADA R's #57 Moshchuk cuts in and shoots, 2-1
3rd period, clock 12:28: LADA R's #57 Moshchuk again, from a scramble at the crease, 2-2
2nd period, clock 16:16: tripping; the board ran 3:00, 4 on 4 for the first 76 s
3rd period, clock 1:18: slashing, 2:00; 0:42 still to serve at the final horn
